name: Hanakage -Ochita Mitsuka-
source:
Seven years have passed after the prequel "Hanamachi Monogatari" story. "Hanakage" takes place in the Meiji Era in Japan.

The main character, Kirishima Iori, is one of the most popular prostitutes in the male x male red-light district Hanabishi, located in the town of Hanamachi.

Iori originally came from a prestigious family of Samurai. However, his father has accumulated a high sum of debt and committed suicide. In order to protect his mother, Iori chose the path of being a prostitute.Though Iori worked as a lowly prostitute, he has not lost his pride. He was often blunt and impolite to his patrons, which got him into trouble with the owner Tatsumi.

"No matter how inferior I've fallen, pride is the only thing I would never lose!"

Meeting with many other men at Hanabishi, what will be Iori's fate?

[Edited from YaoiOtaku]
translation:
前作《花町物语》的故事结束七年后，《花阴》的舞台来到日本明治时代。

主人公桐岛伊织是男色花街花菱最受欢迎的男娼之一。花菱位于花町。

伊织原本出身名门武士家族，父亲却欠下巨额债务并自杀身亡。为了保护母亲，伊织选择出卖身体。即使身为地位低下的男娼，他依然没有失去自尊，经常对客人直言不讳、态度无礼，也因此不断与老板辰巳发生冲突。

“无论堕落到何种地步，我唯独绝不会舍弃尊严！”

在花菱与形形色色的男人相遇后，伊织将迎来怎样的命运？

[编辑自YaoiOtaku]
